definitions.explanation: A competitive event or sport where participants compete against each other.

examples.japanese: {陸上|りくじょう}{競技|きょうぎ}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like track and field events.

examples.japanese: {競技|きょうぎ}に{参加|さんか}する。
この{競技|きょうぎ}のルールを{説明|せつめい}する。
examples.english: To explain the rules of this event.

notes:
{競技|きょうぎ} refers to sports events and competitions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {競技|きょうぎ}に{参加|さんか}する (to participate in a competition)
- {競技|きょうぎ}を{行|おこな}う (to hold a competition)
- 〜{競技|きょうぎ} (~ event/sport)

TYPES OF EVENTS:
- {陸上|りくじょう}{競技|きょうぎ} (track and field)
- {水泳|すいえい}{競技|きょうぎ} (swimming events)
- {球技|きゅうぎ} (ball sports)
- {団体|だんたい}{競技|きょうぎ} (team sports)
- {個人|こじん}{競技|きょうぎ} (individual events)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {競技|きょうぎ}{場|じょう} (stadium, arena)
- {競技|きょうぎ}{会|かい} (athletic meet)
- {競技|きょうぎ}{者|しゃ} (competitor, athlete)

HOMOPHONE:
- {協議|きょうぎ} (discussion, negotiation) - different meaning
